texts.preamble: Bhanwarlal vs Food And Drugs Administration ... on 15 December, 2016 Mcrc-12203-2016 (Bhanwarlal Vs Food And Drugs Administration Thru.Sanjeev Kumar) 15-12-2016 Shri Ashish Gupta, learned counsel for the applicant.
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the State submits that there is provision of appeal against the impugned order before the appellate Tribunal established under Food Safety and Standard Act. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that he will enquire whether such an appellate Tribunal has been notified for the order or not and seeks adjournment for this purpose. He further submits that till then recovery proceedings be stayed. Learned counsel for the State vehemently objects and submits that before maintainability of this petition is decided, stay should not be granted.
